note: What a client sends back when a server states the match clock, carrying both readings so the server can tell how far apart they are. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: The client id the sender holds.

fields.name: serverSaid
fields.note: The time the server stated, carried back.

fields.name: clientSaid
fields.note: What the client's clock reads after taking it.

fields.name: digest
fields.note: The same thirty two bytes from every client of the build; they carry nothing a server needs.

fields.name: value
fields.note: A value the client takes from its connection; what it means is not recorded, and a server ignores it.

fields.name: serverSaid
fields.note: What the server last said the clock stood at, in seconds.

fields.name: clientSaid
fields.note: What the client's own clock stood at when that statement arrived, in seconds.

fields.name: check
fields.note: Thirty-two bytes every client of this build sends alike; a server ignores them.

fields.name: serverSaid
fields.note: What the server last said the clock stood at, in seconds.

fields.name: clientSaid
fields.note: What the client's own clock stood at when that statement arrived, in seconds.
